text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Curren Chan stops by a certain
forest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Um... If I just take this path...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That's sooo cool! ♪ There really is
a
waterfall!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ack! I've gotta hurry up and take a pic!
The light's
best at 6 a.m. at this time of
year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow! People are already commenting!
..."What an
angel." "The definition of
cute." "Divine cuteness."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Coming all the way out here was
so worth
it. Now I just gotta...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan shows up for training
looking a little
more tired than usual.
